name: Pancrates
bio: Pancrates is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no date for the poet. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of Meleager's Wreath, the Garland compiled about 100 BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 653).

poems.title: Book VII, 653
poems.author: Pancrates
poems.text: Ar the setting of the Hyades the fierce Sirocco rose and destroyed Epierides in the Aegean Sea, himself, his ship and crew; and for him his father in tears made this empty tomb.
